title: Where zaproxy history begins
description: The earliest commits in the zaproxy repository, and traces of its Subversion past in later commit messages.

chapters.title: The first commits
chapters.text: The earliest commit in the repository is "Initial directory structure." dated 2010-08-16. The commit "Version 1.0.0" follows on 2010-09-04.

evidence.label: ZAP history page (lists 2009-2010 entries; still being written)

chapters.title: Subversion-era messages
chapters.text: Commit messages from 2011 and 2012 still mention svn, for example "Exclude svn data when copying files" (2011-03-02) and "merged changes on trunk into websockets branch fixed svn:ignore to ignore only eclipse files" (2012-05-12). This shows the project used Subversion at the time; these commits do not say where it was hosted.
